name: openfda-mcp-server
description: Query FDA data on drugs, food, devices, and recalls via openFDA. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

openfda_api_key.title: openFDA API Key
openfda_api_key.description: Free API key from open.fda.gov — increases daily limit from 1K to 120K requests. Register at https://open.fda.gov/apis/authentication/.

openfda_mirror_enabled.title: Enable local bulk mirror
openfda_mirror_enabled.description: Set to true to answer exact-key lookups for drug/label, drug/ndc, drug/enforcement, and drug/drugsfda from a local SQLite copy of the openFDA bulk downloads. Requires an out-of-band harvest (mirror:init) before it serves anything.

openfda_mirror_path.title: Mirror directory
openfda_mirror_path.description: Directory holding one SQLite file per mirrored dataset.

openfda_mirror_refresh_cron.title: Mirror refresh schedule
openfda_mirror_refresh_cron.description: Cron expression for the in-process refresh. Applies to the HTTP transport only; run mirror:refresh from the host otherwise. Requires the optional node-cron peer dependency.

openfda_mirror_fallback_live.title: Fall back to the live API
openfda_mirror_fallback_live.description: Leave true so a cold, stale, or failing mirror transparently falls back to the openFDA API.

openfda_mirror_refresh_timeout_ms.title: Refresh timeout (ms)
openfda_mirror_refresh_timeout_ms.description: Wall-clock budget for one scheduled refresh before it is aborted. Raise it for drug/label, the only multi-partition dataset.
